title: Polish Open Science Platform
main_text: Polish Open Science Platform We support the development of Polish science and innovation by offering modern tools and access to unique research data. All Resources Datasets Publications Software Services Data sources Catalogues Providers Organisations Interoperability Guidelines Trainings Browse Exact match What can you explore on our platform? Explore the catalogue Find the resources you need quickly and easily. Simple and intuitive discovery Filters tailored to your needs Instant access to key information Browse resources Request resources and track your orders Request and manage resources online. Less paperwork, more control in one place. Easy ordering Order management Project managment in one place Learn how ordering works Provide your resources and reach a wider audience Share your resources with the European research community and manage requests in one place. Service and offer management Requests and ordering Visibility across Europe Contact our team Our Data Sources Our data sources bring together trusted research outputs, institutional repositories, and verified scientific datasets in one connected ecosystem. Access reliable, high-quality data from across Poland and Europe ready to discover, reuse, and build upon. Browse Data Sources Slide 1 of 5 ROHub ROHub ROHub enables the management, sharing and preservation of research artefacts related to a particular investigation/research challenge as a single information unit through the Research Object (RO) concept and model. Poznan Supercomputing and Networking Center Slide 2 of 5 RODBUK Cracow Open Research Data Repository The purpose of RODBUK is to collect, develop, archive and make available in open access all types of research data created by researchers, PhD candidates and students in the course of scientific activity. Academic Computer Centre CYFRONET AGH Slide 3 of 5 Bridge of Knowledge Open Research Data Catalog The nature of the ‘Bridge of Data’ project is to design and build a platform that allows collecting, searching, analyzing and sharing open research data and to provide it with unique data collected from the three most important Pomeranian universities Gdańsk University of Technology Slide 4 of 5 RepOD Repository for Open Data RepOD is the first Polish repository for open research data. All researchers, regardless of affiliation and academic discipline, can create a free account and start sharing data produced, collected, or described during research activities. Interdisciplinary Centre for Mathematical and Computational Modelling, University of Warsaw Slide 5 of 5 Oceanographic Data and Information System eCUDO.pl The eCUDO.pl project is created by a consortium of Project partners. These are research units, scientific institutes and universities whose scientific activity focuses on the area of knowledge related to the seas and oceans. Institute of Oceanology Polish Academy of Sciences Previous Next Work with data Within distributed infrastructures and collaborate on research data across infrastructures Work with shared research data in one environment. Upload files, manage access, and collaborate on the same data across providers and compute infrastructures. Shared data spaces Distributed data replication Team collaboration Sign-in to workspace Related Initiatives EOSC Beyond EOSC Beyond is a project developed within the European Open Science Cloud framework to strengthen collaboration among researchers across Europe. It introduces new capabilities to the EOSC Core services and helps research service providers access, integrate, and share resources more effectively. eosc.gov.pl EOSC.gov.pl is an initiative of the Polish EOSC partnership that supports the development of open science in Poland. It provides information on national EOSC-related activities and serves as a space for sharing experiences and good practices among institutions involved in open science. EOSC Association EOSC Association brings together institutions and organisations committed to building an open scientific ecosystem in Europe. It supports collaboration, common standards, and the development of sustainable infrastructure that improves access to research data, tools, and services. Marie Skłodowska-Curie and Pierre Curie in their laboratory in Paris, circa 1900–1906. Source: National Library of France (Gallica). License: Public domain . About eosc.pl The Polish Open Science Platform is part of the European Open Science Cloud, which supports open access to research resources across Europe. As a national EOSC node, the platform helps researchers access data, publications, and infrastructure for advanced research and international collaboration. Become a provider Ready to share your resources? We are here to help. Join the EOSC ecosystem and make your services, data, and tools visible to the European research community. Our team supports you throughout the onboarding process. Contact our team Adam and Ludwik Zamenhof at the 9th World Esperanto Congress in Bern, 1913. Author: Unknown. Source: Bildarchiv Austria. License: Public domain . Partners

children.main_text: Acceptable Use Policy and Conditions of Use This Acceptable Use Policy and Conditions of Use (“AUP”) defines the rules and conditions that govern your access to and use (including transmission, processing, and storage of data) of the resources and services (“Services”) as granted by the ACC Cyfronet AGH for the purpose of the Search Service platform (hereinafter referred to as "Website"), where User can search through a variety of resources, including: publications, data, software, services, and trainings. Users should read, understand and accept this AUP when creating an account on the Website or using any of the services provided via this Website. If a given user has not done this, or does not agree with the terms set out in this document, that user should not create an account on the Website and should not make use of any of the services provided via this Website. By accepting this AUP, the registered User, enters into agreement with ACC Cyfronet AGH, made up by the contents of these terms, in order to regulate the user’s access and use of the Website. User who accept these AUP hereby represent and warrant that: You accept to be bound by these AUP, as registered Website user – either individually, or in representation of an organization; You are capable, under the terms of the applicable law, to be legally bound by and comply with these AUP – in particular, whenever a you create an account as a representative of an organization, that you warrant to have been expressly and validly authorized by that organization to do so, or to otherwise be a legitimate representative of that organization under the applicable law; You shall only use the Services in a manner consistent with the purposes and limitations described above; you shall show consideration towards other users including by not causing harm to the Services; you have an obligation to collaborate in the resolution of issues arising from your use of the Services. You shall only use the Services for lawful purposes and not breach, attempt to breach, nor circumvent administrative or security controls. You shall respect intellectual property and confidentiality agreements. You shall protect your access credentials (e.g. passwords, private keys or multi-factor tokens); no intentional sharing is permitted. You shall keep your registered information correct and up to date. You shall promptly report known or suspected security breaches, credential compromise or misuse to the security contact stated below; and report any compromised credentials to the relevant issuing authorities. Reliance on the Services shall only be to the extent specified by any applicable service level agreements listed below. Use without such agreements is at your own risk. Your personal data will be processed in accordance with the Privacy Policy of the EOSC Search Service. Your use of the Services may be restricted or suspended, for administrative, operational, or security reasons, without prior notice and without compensation. If you violate these rules, you may be liable for the consequences, which may include your account being suspended and a report being made to your home organisation or to law enforcement. Services provided via the Website: Access to services provided via Website is, in part, restricted to registered users - although some Services are open to all Website users. The creation of an account and access to the Website is free of charge. Registered members The Website is intended to allow individuals to become part of the Website community and use the EOSC Search Service solutions. In particular, by creating a registered account, users will be able to become actively involved in EOSC Search Service work and receive personalized recommendations based on the User's scientific interests and activity and on the Website. Newsletters and communications The ACC Cyfronet AGH will include members of EOSC Search Service within specific mailing lists, to ensure that those members are kept updated regarding important news and events related to the Website’s scope, by sending out informative newsletters and other communications to registered users (unless they opt-out of this). Events EOSC Search Service may organize meetings for its community of registered users, which take place in different places around Europe and beyond, seeking to bring together a unique community of research data practitioners and industry and policy stakeholders to pursue the specific objectives of EOSC Search Service . Via Website, registered users are able to sign-up to attend events and webinars for free or at a cost (paid via an external payment processor). More information on Events is available at: eosc.pl User support Any questions concerning Website activities in general can be addressed to the EOSC Search Service via helpdesk. Registered users can address questions specifically referring to the operation and use of the Website by creating the ticket in EOSC Helpdesk. Copyright / Intellectual Property Users of the Website may download or print copies of any and all materials on the Website for personal use. None of the information on this Website may be copied, distributed or transmitted in any way for commercial use. For any materials downloaded from this Website, source and references must be acknowledged. The administrative and security contact for this AUP is: contact@eosc.pl . The privacy statements are located at: Privacy Policy of the EOSC Search Service . Liability The material on this Website is provided for general information only. ACC Cyfronet AGH makes no representations or warranties as to the accuracy or completeness of any materials and information incorporated thereto and contained on this Website. ACC Cyfronet AGH has a policy of continuous improvement of its communication and reserves the right to make improvements or changes to the online content without notice. The use of the material (or any information incorporated thereto), in whole or in part, contained in this Website is the user’s sole responsibility. ACC Cyfronet AGH disclaims any liability for any damages whatsoever including, without limitation, direct, indirect, incidental and/or consequential damages resulting from access to the website and use of the materials provided therein. ACC Cyfronet AGH makes no representations about websites accessed through the EOSC Search Service which are not maintained, controlled or created by ACC Cyfronet AGH. Cyfronet does not endorse these sites and is not responsible for their content.
